mechanism: Bupropion inhibits CYP2D6, which may increase primaquine metabolism via alternative pathways and potentially affect its antimalarial efficacy; primaquine also carries inherent risk of hemolysis in G6PD-deficient patients independent of bupropion.
action: Monitor for reduced antimalarial efficacy and hemolytic anemia; consider alternative antidepressant or antimalarial if G6PD deficiency present; assess baseline CBC and G6PD status before primaquine initiation.
